summary: Lead with what only you have: chai in clay cups, made in front of people, and a busy evening crowd [s3].
Post 4 times a week on Instagram, mostly Reels, and keep WhatsApp Status for daily specials.
Fill the quiet mornings: show the cafe as a calm place to work, which locals are asking for [s4].
Measure what brings people in: saves, shares, direction taps and the code on the menu board.

items: Instagram 2,140 followers on 14 Oct 2026; posts are photos of drinks with no faces.
Google rating 4.6 from 312 reviews; people love the clay cups and the evening buzz [s3].
Weekend reviews mention slow service: answer them and show the team at work [s3].

blocks.text:
Make Kulhad Cafe the neighbourhood's favourite chai stop: lively in the evening, calm in the morning, and always made in front of you.

Instagram builds the wish to come; WhatsApp Status turns regulars into repeat visits; Google Maps is where people decide.
